ideas.pitch: A real-time computer vision system using YOLOv8 and OpenCV to detect safety violations (like missing helmets or unauthorized zone entry) across CCTV feeds for campus and industrial compliance.
ideas.title: CampusEye: Automated Industrial & Campus Safety Computer Vision Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the offline round's explicit focus on practical Computer Vision skills and real-world industrial compliance problems assessed at Chandigarh University.

ideas.pitch: A mobile-first web app that processes leaf images via a fine-tuned CNN to detect plant diseases instantly and forecasts regional crop yield using tabular weather metrics.
ideas.title: AgriVision AI: Crop Disease Detection and Yield Prediction Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines both Machine Learning and Computer Vision themes required by the hackathon into a single impactful application tailored for agricultural regions in India.

ideas.pitch: An OCR and NLP pipeline that extracts handwritten medication names from prescriptions, cross-references dosages against a safety database, and flags potentially dangerous drug interactions.
ideas.title: DocAudit: Automated Medical Prescription Digitization & Anomaly Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates advanced OCR combined with core Machine Learning classification, appealing directly to judges evaluating rigorous technical implementations.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision platform that ingests traffic camera feeds to count vehicles in real-time, compute congestion scores, and dynamically optimize signal timing suggestions.
ideas.title: TrafficFlow CV: Intelligent Intersection Density Estimator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an urgent, tangible real-world problem using standard Computer Vision methodologies that judges can easily visualize and test live.

ideas.pitch: A machine learning platform utilizing scikit-learn and LightGBM to analyze student attendance, assignment scores, and engagement metrics to predict academic risk before exams.
ideas.title: EduPredict: Student Performance Risk and Dropout Early Warning System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly applies core Machine Learning concepts to an academic setting, resonating well with faculty judges at Chandigarh University.
